title: AGF Ragdoll components
description: Component + template definitions for the engine ragdoll module. RagdollTemplate is a data-only description registered at bootstrap; per-instance state lives on RagdollState + RagdollBody + RagdollJoint entity components spawned by RagdollSpawnSystem (S127+). RagdollSpawnRequest is the project-facing trigger; RagdollTeardownRequest is the explicit disposal trigger.

ragdollBodyDef.description: S126 — one rigid body in a ragdoll template. dimensions[] semantics depend on shape: box -> [w, h, d]; capsule -> [radius, halfHeight, 0]; sphere -> [radius, 0, 0].

name.description: Body identifier (matches the project's skeleton naming, e.g. 'torso', 'head', 'upperArm.l').

anchor.description: Local-space offset from the skeleton root to this body's centre.

mass.description: Optional override; defaults to Rapier's auto-mass from shape.

ragdollJointDef.description: S126 — one constraint between two bodies in the template. Joint type drives the Rapier constraint; anchors are in each body's local space.

axis.description: Required for revolute joints. Unit vector in the parent body's local space.

ragdollTemplate.description: S126 — full template registered at bootstrap. Bodies[] declares each rigid body; joints[] declares the constraint graph. Per-instance state is spawned by RagdollSpawnSystem (S127+).

ragdollSpawnRequest.description: S126 — project writes this on a skeleton root entity to ask the engine to spawn a Rapier ragdoll. The spawn system consumes + removes the request, then writes RagdollState + RagdollActive on the root.

impulse.description: Optional initial impulse applied to all bodies (or the root body). Useful for blast-driven ragdolls.

meshMap.description: S131 — optional mapping from body name (matches RagdollBodyDef.name) to an existing mesh entity id. The spawn system writes a RagdollMeshBinding on each mapped mesh; the sync system then mirrors that body's Transform onto the mesh each fixed tick. Partial maps are fine; unmapped bodies + unknown body names are ignored silently.

ragdollTeardownRequest.description: S126 — explicit despawn signal. RagdollTeardownSystem (S127+) disposes the Rapier bodies + joints, removes the body + joint entities, clears RagdollState + RagdollActive from the root.

ragdollState.description: S126 — per-instance state spawned by RagdollSpawnSystem on the skeleton root. bodyEntities maps body name to its ECS entity id; jointEntities is the parallel list of joint entity ids; meshEntities (S131) is the parallel list of mesh entity ids that were bound via the request's meshMap, used by teardown to clear bindings.

meshEntities.description: S131 — mesh entity ids bound by the spawn system. Empty array when no meshMap was provided. Teardown removes RagdollMeshBinding from each.

ragdollMeshBinding.description: S131 — runtime-only binding written by RagdollSpawnSystem on a project-owned mesh entity. While present, RagdollSyncSystem copies the named body's Transform onto the mesh each fixed tick. Cleared by RagdollTeardownSystem when the ragdoll despawns.

ragdollBody.description: S126 — component on each rigid body entity spawned by RagdollSpawnSystem. Links back to the skeleton root + holds the Rapier body handle.

ragdollJoint.description: S126 — component on each joint entity spawned by RagdollSpawnSystem.

ragdollActive.description: S126 — marker on the skeleton root telling animation systems to skip this entity while the ragdoll is in flight. Removed by RagdollTeardownSystem.
